class Node:
    """A doubly linked list node to store key-value pairs."""
    def __init__(self, key: int, value: int):
        self.key = key
        self.value = value
        self.prev = None
        self.next = None

class LRUCache:
    """A Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache that implements O(1) get and put methods using a combination of a hashmap and a doubly linked list."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = Node(0, 0)
        self.tail = Node(0, 0)
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head

    def _remove(self, node: Node) -> None:
        """Remove a node from the linked list."""
        prev_node = node.prev
        next_node = node.next
        prev_node.next = next_node
        next_node.prev = prev_node

    def _add_to_head(self, node: Node) -> None:
        """Add a node right after the head."""
        node.prev = self.head
        node.next = self.head.next
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def _pop_tail(self) -> Node:
        """Pop the last node from the linked list."""
        tail_node = self.tail.prev
        self._remove(tail_node)
        return tail_node

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        """Return the value of the key if present, otherwise return -1."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            self._add_to_head(node)
            return node.value
        return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        """Add a key-value pair to the cache."""
        if key in self.cache:
            self._remove(self.cache[key])
        node = Node(key, value)
        self._add_to_head(node)
        self.cache[key] = node
        if len(self.cache) > self.capacity:
            tail_node = self._pop_tail()
            del self.cache[tail_node.key]

class LRUCache:
    """A Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache that implements O(1) get and put methods using a hashmap and a circularly linked list."""
    
    class Node:
        """A node for the circular linked list to hold key-value pairs."""
        def __init__(self, key: int, value: int):
            self.key = key
            self.value = value
            self.prev = None
            self.next = None

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = self.Node(0, 0)
        self.head.prev = self.head
        self.head.next = self.head

    def _add_node(self, node: Node) -> None:
        """Add a new node right after head."""
        node.prev = self.head
        node.next = self.head.next
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def _remove_node(self, node: Node) -> None:
        """Remove an existing node from the linked list."""
        prev_node = node.prev
        next_node = node.next
        prev_node.next = next_node
        next_node.prev = prev_node

    def _pop_tail(self) -> Node:
        """Remove the last node (the least recently used) from the linked list and return it."""
        tail = self.head.prev
        self._remove_node(tail)
        return tail

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        """Return the value of the key if it exists in the cache; otherwise, return -1."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove_node(node)
            self._add_node(node)
            return node.value
        return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        """Insert a key-value pair into the cache."""
        if key in self.cache:
            self._remove_node(self.cache[key])
        new_node = self.Node(key, value)
        self._add_node(new_node)
        self.cache[key] = new_node
        if len(self.cache) > self.capacity:
            tail_node = self._pop_tail()
            del self.cache[tail_node.key]
